<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>x_938076_now_utils.TaskPriorityCalc</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>true</client_callable>
        <description>Calculation of task priority dynamically  based on configuration values.
//SN5106 - Dynamic Prioritization</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>TaskPriorityCalc</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var TaskPriorityCalc = Class.create();
TaskPriorityCalc.prototype = prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    calculate: function(taskGR, tableName) {
        var score = 0;
        var workNotes = "";
        var configureRules = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_o_task_priority_config');
        configureRules.addQuery('enabled', true);
        configureRules.addQuery('table', tableName);
        configureRules.query();
        while (configureRules.next()) {
            var isMatch = GlideFilter.checkRecord(taskGR, configureRules.getValue('conditions'));
            if (isMatch) {
                var readableCondition = configureRules.getValue('conditions');
                var readableQuery = new global.GlobalQueryUtil().getReadableQuery(tableName, readableCondition);
                workNotes += 'Getting ' + configureRules.getValue('points') + ' points, condition: ' + readableQuery + '\n';
                score = score + parseFloat(configureRules.getValue('points'));
            }
        }

        return {
            priority: this.mapPointsToPriority(score),
            workNotes: workNotes
        };
    },

    mapPointsToPriority: function(points) {
        if (points >= 90) {
            return 1;
        } else if (points >= 50) {
            return 2;
        } else if (points >= 20) {
            return 3;
        } else {
            return 4;
        }
    },
    getuserDepartment: function() {
        function splitRoles(propName) {
            var v = gs.getProperty(propName, '') + '';
            if (!v) return [];
            var arr = v.split(',');
            for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) arr[i] = (arr[i] || '').trim();
            return arr;
        }

        function hasAnyRole(list) {
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                if (list[i] && gs.hasRole(list[i])) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        var equity = hasAnyRole(splitRoles('x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_o.cash_equities_roles_to_select_target_app'));
        var custody = hasAnyRole(splitRoles('x_hsb11_hsbc_mss_o.custody_roles_to_select_target_app'));
        if (custody && equity) return 'both';
        if (equity) return 'equity';
        if (custody) return 'custody';
        return ''; // same behavior as "undefined" for client comparisons (no rule matched)
    },


    convertStringToDateTimeByEntity: function(dateStr, entity, viewTz) {
        if (!dateStr) {
			return null;
        }

        var normalizedDate = normalizeDateString(dateStr);
        var ent = entity || '';
        var baseline = viewTz || 'GMT';
        if (ent === 'HSI') {
            baseline = 'America/New_York';
        } else if (ent === 'HBAP') {
            baseline = 'Asia/Hong_Kong';
        }

        var gdt = stringToGlideDateTimeByBaseline(normalizedDate, baseline);
        return gdt;



        function normalizeDateString(dateStr) {
            if (/^\d{8}$/.test(dateStr)) {
                return dateStr.substring(0, 4) + '-' + dateStr.substring(4, 6) + '-' + dateStr.substring(6, 8);
            }

            if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(dateStr)) {
                return dateStr;
            }

            throw 'Unsupported date format: ' + dateStr;
        }

        function stringToGlideDateTimeByBaseline(dateOnly, tzName) {
            var offsetHours = getOffsetHours(dateOnly, tzName);
            var utcDateTime = addHoursToDateTimeString(dateOnly + ' 00:00:00', -offsetHours);

            return new GlideDateTime(utcDateTime);
        }

        function getOffsetHours(dateOnly, tzName) {
            if (tzName === 'GMT') {
                return 0;
            }

            if (tzName === 'Asia/Hong_Kong') {
                return 8;
            }

            // Default to America/New_York-style Eastern time.
            if (tzName && tzName !== 'America/New_York') {
                return 0;
            }

            var year = parseInt(dateOnly.substring(0, 4), 10);
            var dstStart = getSecondSundayOfMarch(year);
            var dstEnd = getFirstSundayOfNovember(year);

            // For a date-only value interpreted as midnight local time:
            // - Before the DST start date: EST (-5)
            // - From the day after DST start through the DST end date: EDT (-4)
            // - After DST end date: EST (-5)
            if (dateOnly > dstStart && dateOnly <= dstEnd) {
                return -4;
            }

            return -5;
        }

        function getSecondSundayOfMarch(year) {
            return getNthSundayOfMonth(year, 3, 2);
        }

        function getFirstSundayOfNovember(year) {
            return getNthSundayOfMonth(year, 11, 1);
        }

        function getNthSundayOfMonth(year, month, occurrence) {
            var firstDay = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, 1));
            var firstSundayOffset = (7 - firstDay.getUTCDay()) % 7;
            var dayOfMonth = 1 + firstSundayOffset + (occurrence - 1) * 7;
            return pad4(year) + '-' + pad2(month) + '-' + pad2(dayOfMonth);
        }

        function addHoursToDateTimeString(dateTimeStr, hoursToAdd) {
            var year = parseInt(dateTimeStr.substring(0, 4), 10);
            var month = parseInt(dateTimeStr.substring(5, 7), 10);
            var day = parseInt(dateTimeStr.substring(8, 10), 10);
            var hour = parseInt(dateTimeStr.substring(11, 13), 10);
            var minute = parseInt(dateTimeStr.substring(14, 16), 10);
            var second = parseInt(dateTimeStr.substring(17, 19), 10);

            var utcMillis = Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute, second);
            utcMillis += hoursToAdd * 60 * 60 * 1000;

            var adjusted = new Date(utcMillis);
            return adjusted.getUTCFullYear() + '-' + pad2(adjusted.getUTCMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad2(adjusted.getUTCDate()) + ' ' + pad2(adjusted.getUTCHours()) + ':' + pad2(adjusted.getUTCMinutes()) + ':' + pad2(adjusted.getUTCSeconds());
        }

        function pad2(value) {
            return (value < 10 ? '0' : '') + value;
        }

        function pad4(value) {
            var text = String(value);
            while (text.length < 4) {
                text = '0' + text;
            }
            return text;
        }
    },




    type: 'TaskPriorityCalc'
});]]></script>
